# Template: forest_plot
A meta-analysis forest plot: one row per study with a square point- estimate marker (sized by weight) and a horizontal confidence-interval whisker, a dashed null-effect reference line, and an optional pooled estimate drawn as a diamond spanning its own confidence interval. Ratio measures (risk ratio, odds ratio, hazard ratio) are positioned on a LOG scale so equal fold-changes are equally spaced, with the null line at 1; mean-difference is positioned on a linear scale with the null line at 0. Choose this scene for ANY request about a forest plot, meta-analysis, pooled estimate, pooled effect, confidence interval, risk ratio, odds ratio, hazard ratio, mean difference, heterogeneity, or combining evidence across studies. Every estimate takes a typed number or a code element's variable via a "{id.var}" token — a meta-analysis the script actually ran. TYPE each study's `label` (and `measure`) by hand: the typed names are what keep the study_i / ci_i / pooled beats alive before the script has run, and a row still waiting for its numbers draws on the null line with a dash for its value, never an invented interval.

Element ids your commands can reference:
- null_line: dashed vertical reference line at the null effect
- study_<i>: square point-estimate marker for studies[i] (counted from 0), sized by weight
- ci_<i>: its horizontal confidence-interval whisker
- study_label_<i>: its study-name label, left column
- est_label_<i>: its "est [lo, hi]" text, right column
- pooled: the pooled-estimate diamond, present when `pooled` is set
- pooled_label: the pooled diamond's name + "est [lo, hi]" text, present when `pooled` is set
- axis: the horizontal value axis with tick labels
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a meta-analysis forest plot pooling four studies of a treatment's risk ratio." → params: {"measure":"RR","studies":[{"label":"Anderson 2015","est":0.82,"lo":0.63,"hi":1.07,"weight":6},{"label":"Bianchi 2017","est":0.71,"lo":0.55,"hi":0.92,"weight":8},{"label":"Carter 2019","est":0.9,"lo":0.68,"hi":1.19,"weight":5},{"label":"Diallo 2021","est":0.65,"lo":0.48,"hi":0.88,"weight":7}],"pooled":{"est":0.76,"lo":0.65,"hi":0.89},"title":"Risk of relapse: pooled analysis"}
Request: "Show a forest plot of mean differences from three trials." → params: {"measure":"MD","studies":[{"label":"Trial 1","est":-2.1,"lo":-4,"hi":-0.2,"weight":5},{"label":"Trial 2","est":-1.4,"lo":-3.1,"hi":0.3,"weight":4},{"label":"Trial 3","est":-3,"lo":-5.2,"hi":-0.8,"weight":6}]}

In YAML: `template: forest_plot` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
